nodes.statement: Restricted theorem lane active: HC-R021-A8-CM4-C2 is selected; construct cycles for every allowed codimension-two rational Hodge class on C_CM4.
Fix the Markman genus-four real-multiplication source datum, associated degree-four CM field, and nonempty Weil-type deformation component.
Restrict to the Hodge-generic locus where Hdg^4 is generated by divisor products plus HW; construct the divisor-product preimage for every allowed alpha.
Construct coherent B-secant sheaves satisfying the source hypotheses.
Prove the Fourier-Mukai/Orlov object has nonzero rank.
Prove the normalized class kappa(E) remains of Hodge type under the relevant Weil-type deformations.
Prove kappa_2(E) has a nonzero projection to HW.
If the semiregularity map is injective on the image of the ambient evaluation/Atiyah map, every first-order Hodge-preserving ambient obstruction in that image vanishes.

Familywise Perry reduction: on any bound smooth proper CM/Weil family carrying the global Hodge-persistent flat class kappa(E_0), weak G-semiregularity plus Ext<0=0 lets Perry make kappa algebraic on every fiber.

For any finite translation subgroup H, the orbit sum of a coherent/perfect secant object has a canonical H-linearization and Chern character |H| times the original; finite-equivariant representatives on the same secant ray are available.
For the Example 11.2.7 second-factor gluing family with ch(F)=N[D-(q/6)H^3], ext^2(F,F)>=8qN^2-2; ordinary semiregularity is impossible when qN^2>=4.
Restricted semiregularity on Im(ob_F) is equivalent to ker(ob_F)=ker((bullet) contraction ch(F)); compatibility always gives ker(ob_F) subset ker(contraction).
For beta-prime=g^*Theta-(q/6)(g^-1)^*(Theta^3), the exact HKR contraction map HT^2(X)->H_Omega^{-2}(X) has rank 20 and kernel dimension 8.
For any fixed admissible Example 11.2.7 object E, rank(ob_E)=20 iff the eight explicit generators k1,...,k8 of ker(contraction beta-prime) all vanish under ev_E in Ext^2(E,E).
Example 11.2.7 specifies an admissible gluing family rather than one canonical object; the common Chern character does not determine the object-specific obstruction map or eight Yoneda classes.

On an algebraic family of admissible gluings, D20={rank(ob_E)<=20} is determinantal closed; compatibility plus L006 forces rank>=20, so D20 is exactly the rank-20 locus and common zero locus of the eight L007 relations.

After fixing one source-admissible discrete datum, the Example 11.2.7 curve, translation, line-bundle, and constituent-wise gluing choices form a nonempty finite-type algebraic stack S_adm carrying a universal relatively perfect family after flattening.

For a simple gluing whose N principal-divisor constituents form one transitive finite translation orbit G, |G|=N and dim Ext^2(E,E)^G>=8qN-2. Invariant dimension can force rank 20 only when qN<=2; full invariant-Ext2 semiregularity is impossible when qN>=4.
For every positive integral q and all sufficiently large m, choosing N=6 and d=q m^3 gives an explicit effective correction-curve class via dD^3-qH^3=q(mD-H)(m^2D^2+mDH+H^2), with mD-H ample.

The six H^1(T_X) generators k1,...,k6 of ker(c_beta-prime) are exactly the simultaneous first-order Hodge-preserving tangent space T_Hdg(D) intersect T_Hdg(H); k7,k8 are genuinely mixed H^2(O_X)+H^0(Lambda^2T_X) directions.

A sufficiently small full-level PEL cover of the selected connected Weil-type period component carries a universal abelian scheme and Markman's Spin(V)_{eta,B}-invariant normalized class descends to a global flat rational section which is Hodge on every fiber; every C_CM4 point lifts to this cover.

There is an explicit split perfect complex P_beta with ch(P_beta)=12 beta-prime, ker(ob_P_beta)=span(k1,...,k6), and rank(ob_P_beta)=22; the two mixed classes k7,k8 are nonzero even though Markman's downstream Weil-projection interface applies.

No nonzero split complex of shifted line bundles can satisfy all eight beta-prime kernel relations: killing k1,...,k6 forces each line-bundle Chern class to A U+B V, after which ev(k7)=(qa+A^2)y12 and ev(k8)=(qb+B^2)y34 are nonzero. A positive perfect-complex route must therefore be genuinely non-formal or non-line-bundle.

For any finite translation-plus-degree-zero-twist subgroup preserving an Example 11.2.7 coherent second-factor gluing, projection to translations is faithful and |G|<=N; hence dim Ext^2(E,E)^G>=8qN-2 and the second factor cannot be weakly G-semiregular when qN>=4. The explicit N=6 tranche is included.

For finite identity-component autoequivalence actions on an abelian variety, Perry weak G-semiregularity coincides with G-semiregularity on the relevant degree-two obstruction source; for P=E0 boxtimes E-prime, weak G-semiregularity of the total object forces every second-factor contraction-kernel direction to vanish under ob_E-prime, hence forces second-factor rank 20.
Construct a nonempty admissible algebraic gluing parameter stack with universal relatively perfect object.
Pass to flattening/base-change strata where relative Ext^2 is locally free and the relative obstruction morphism is a vector-bundle map.
Define D20; by L006-L009 it is exactly the simultaneous zero locus of the eight L007 Yoneda relations.
Construct an admissible gluing deforming in all six simultaneous D,H Hodge-preserving directions k1,...,k6, or otherwise prove the six corresponding Yoneda classes vanish at one admissible point.
At the same admissible point, prove the two mixed relations ev_E(k7)=ev_E(k8)=0, or exhibit a nonzero mixed obstruction and refute that point.
Prove D20 is nonempty on at least one admissible/simple stratum, equivalently construct one admissible gluing satisfying all eight L007 Yoneda relations.

Construct a genuinely non-formal same-ray perfect complex E-prime with Chern character a nonzero integer multiple of beta-prime, Ext^{<0}(E-prime,E-prime)=0, and all eight beta-prime kernel directions null under its ambient Hochschild action. L015 supplies a rank-22 control and L016 rules out every split line-bundle realization.
Choose E in D20. Then rank(ob_E)=20 and Markman's restricted first-order semiregularity condition holds for E.
After positive A1, prove every successive family obstruction lies in the ambient-obstruction image controlled by restricted semiregularity, yielding all-orders transport without full semiregularity.
Choose a finite-equivariant representative of the first genus-four secant Chern-character ray.
Construct a finite-equivariant representative on the beta-prime ray without changing the nonzero-Weil-projection criterion.

After a second-factor rank-20 object is supplied, prove weak equivariant semiregularity for a genuinely eight-dimensional external-product/Orlov representative, including the mixed Ext^1 tensor Ext^1 contribution. L018 shows this is downstream of, not an alternative to, the second-factor rank-20 condition.
Transport the finite symmetry through the Orlov/Fourier-Mukai equivalence into A_0 x A_0^vee.
Apply Perry familywise to B_0=-c_1(E_0)/rank(E_0) and w_0=kappa(E_0).
Bind the C_CM4 target to an algebraic level-moduli family carrying Markman's class as a global flat Hodge section.

All-orders algebraicity-transport bridge. Every currently viable route first requires a second-factor rank-20/eight-relation object: coherent D20 or a genuinely non-formal same-ray perfect complex. Route G cannot bypass this by L018; after rank 20 it still requires total weak equivariant semiregularity G3. Family coverage G6 is complete.
Produce one nonzero algebraic Weil class on every A in C_CM4.
Use algebraic K-endomorphism correspondences to generate every class in HW(A,eta).
Combine divisor-product and Weil preimages to construct z in CH^2(A) tensor Q for arbitrary alpha in Hdg^4(A,Q).
Universal rational cycle-class surjectivity remains outside this restricted tranche.

forbidden_shortcuts: Assume algebraicity of inverse Lefschetz correspondences or Kunneth projectors without an independent theorem.
Replace rational projective Hodge by the false integral or unrestricted compact-Kahler analogue.
Treat persistence of kappa(E) as a Hodge class as algebraicity transport without semiregularity or an equivalent deformation theorem.
Treat finite equivariance, linearization, or orbit averaging as weak G-semiregularity without proving semiregularity in the invariant category.
Infer semiregularity of an external product from factorwise degree-two injectivity without controlling the mixed Ext^1 tensor Ext^1 summand.
Treat restricted first-order semiregularity on Im(ob_E) as an all-orders deformation theorem without proving obstruction-image stability.
Reverse ker(ob_E) subset ker(contraction): L006 implies rank(ob_E)>=20 and success occurs at the minimal rank 20.
Treat the common Chern character N beta-prime as determining the object-specific obstruction map.
Assume D20 is generic open: rank<=20 is determinantal closed and nonemptiness must be proved.
Identify the full direct-sum fiber with the curve line at a gluing point; gluing is constituent-wise over labeled incidence schemes.
Promote the dimensionally possible (q,N)=(1,2) transitive case to an existing source point; Markman's effectivity argument does not supply N=2.
Treat the six simultaneous D,H Hodge-preserving directions as object-level deformations without constructing a relative gluing family.
Treat a split line-bundle K-theory representative as a D20 object: L015-L016 show the mixed actions survive termwise and every nonzero split line-bundle complex fails the eight-relation criterion.
Attempt to prove G3 by making the coherent second factor weakly G-semiregular for qN>=4: L017 rules this out for every finite translation-plus-twist stabilizer of the gluing.
Treat total weak G-semiregularity as an independent bypass around second-factor D20/rank20: L018 proves total weak G-semiregularity forces all eight second-factor kernel relations.
Treat closure of G6 as algebraicity: L014 supplies only an algebraic family and global flat Hodge section; G3 or another deformation theorem is still required.
Promote a theorem on the Hodge-generic locus to special fibers carrying additional Hodge classes.
Treat numerical, Tate, absolute-Hodge, or motivated evidence as an algebraic-cycle construction.
claim_boundary: HC-R021-A8-CM4-C2 remains unproved. L001-L018 are Solve-level lemmas, controls, or route-pruning/dependency results only. Coherent Route A has an explicit N=6 source tranche but D20 nonemptiness remains open. The split same-ray perfect control has obstruction rank 22 and every split line-bundle complex is ruled out; a positive perfect-complex lane must be genuinely non-formal. L018 proves final weak equivariant semiregularity cannot bypass the second-factor rank-20/eight-relation condition. G6 family coverage is closed, but after rank 20 the genuinely total G3 mixed-Ext problem remains open. A1/A2, P5-P7, HC-P04, and the full Hodge conjecture remain open.
